  • Visitar clientes e realizar atendimentos presenciais, buscando conhecer suas realidades, identificar necessidades e fortalecer relacionamentos.
  • Prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades de negócio, ampliando a cobertura de mercado e a presença da marca nas regiões de atuação.
  • Analisar indicadores de desempenho (sell-in, sell-out, ticket médio, positivação, cobertura etc.) e propor planos de ação para melhoria contínua.
  • Garantir a execução das estratégias comerciais e de trade marketing, junto às áreas de marketing, operações e logística.
  • Planejar e conduzir reuniões comerciais, alinhando campanhas, metas e resultados com a equipe e a Gerência.
  • Representar a empresa em eventos, treinamentos e feiras, fortalecendo a presença institucional e o relacionamento com parceiros.
  • Reportar resultados e oportunidades à Gerência Comercial, contribuindo com análises e sugestões estratégicas.
Atribuições Complementares
  • Mapear regiões e definir prioridades de expansão e cobertura.

title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast‑paced, problem‑solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next‑generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location

This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like
  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server‑class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimise applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centres, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self‑discipline and self‑motivation.
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Sobre a Chlorum Solutions

Na Chlorum, inovamos a forma de produzir e entregar cloro-álcalis e derivados. Há 10 anos, somos pioneiros em um modelo descentralizado de produção, baseado em miniplantas instaladas próximas – ou até dentro – das operações dos nossos clientes.

Nossa solução é ambientalmente sustentável, segura e eficiente, transformando a cadeia tradicional da indústria química com mais proximidade e impacto positivo.

Nós acreditamos nas pessoas e no seu potencial de desenvolvimento. Somos guiados pelo nosso jeito único de ser: valorizamos a agilidade, senso de dono e visão de longo prazo para fazer a diferença. Esses são os pilares que sustentam nossa cultura colaborativa que nos impulsiona.

Liderar as atividades financeiras da empresa, garantindo a gestão eficiente do fluxo de caixa, investimentos, captação de recursos, reestruturação de dívidas e mitigação de riscos financeiros.   • Monitoramento e montagem de cenários de caixa em contextos usuais e de stress, garantindo liquidez adequada para as operações e antecipação de riscos;

  • Garantia de conformidade com regulamentações locais e internacionais, políticas internas, auditorias periódicas e governança financeira;

The Impact You'll Make

Site Operations Leader is responsible for setting operational direction for the Brazil Condensing Unit manufacturing site in Danfoss, who will manage the operation for Condensing Units production and other vertically integrated component production like Sheet metal, copper piping etc. In alignment with global functions, will be responsible for the management of the operation including setup and maintenance of production lines, staffing of blue collar in accordance with the demand and driving the continuous improvement in productivity and capacity towards achieving World Class Manufacturing value chain.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • To ensure manufacturing and maintenance processes' set-up that assure zero unsafe conditions. Frequent dialogues with local management teams to acquire a safe culture.

What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor degree in engineering or comparable degree/experience required.
  • Exemplary leader 8-10 years as a senior manufacturing supervisor or manager in an industrial environment with a group of 20+ people.
  • Experience in Machining, (Torch) Brazing, mechanical assemblies and leak, pressure, and basic electrical testing.
  • Proven organization change/transformation management and required development of personnel and related processes and tools.
  • Excellent fluency in English.
  • Ability to track and productivity follow up, monthly operational cost reporting.
What You'll Get From Us
  • We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

  • We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.
  • You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.
Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification. Our solutions are used in such areas as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, automotive, marine, and off- and on-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for renewable energy, such as solar and wind power, as well as district-energy infrastructure for cities.

Our innovative engineering dates back to 1933. Danfoss is family‑owned, employing more than 39,360 people, serving customers in more than 100 countries through a global footprint of 95 factories.

description:
Company overview

Blue Orange Digital is a boutique data & AI consultancy that delivers enterprise-grade results. We design and build modern data platforms, analytics, and ML/AI Agent solutions for mid‑market and enterprise clients across Private Equity, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Retail.

Our teams work with technologies like Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, and the broader Microsoft ecosystem to turn messy, real-world data into trustworthy, actionable insight. We’re a builder‑led, client‑first culture that prizes ownership, clear communication, and shipping high‑impact work.

Note: Please submit your resume in English, as all application materials must be in English for review and consideration.

Position overview

We are looking for a Full‑Stack Software Engineer who doesn't just write code but architects systems. You will design and build the internal platform that serves as the "operating system" for our company.

This isn't a traditional maintenance role. You will be at the forefront of AI‑augmented development , using the latest tools (Cursor, Claude, etc.) to build sophisticated internal tools, agentic workflows, and high‑performance services. You will treat our internal infrastructure as a product, ensuring our teams can move with unprecedented speed.

Responsibilities What You’ll Do
  • Architect Internal Platforms: Design and scale custom dashboards, APIs, and data models that power our core business operations.
  • Engineer Agentic Workflows: Go beyond simple prompts to integrate OpenAI and Anthropic models into complex, multi‑step autonomous workflows that solve real business problems.
  • Modernize CMS Integration: Manage WordPress not as a standalone site, but as a headless content layer within a larger, modern platform ecosystem.
  • AI-Driven Delivery: Use AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate the entire SDLC—from rapid prototyping and refactoring to generating comprehensive test suites.
  • High‑Leverage Ownership: Take full responsibility for features from initial technical design through to AWS deployment and continuous iteration.
The Tech Stack & Tooling

We believe in using the best tool for the job, powered by the best AI for the dev.

  • Languages: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS.
  • Backend: Node.js, Python (FastAPI/Flask), and RESTful/GraphQL APIs.
  • Platform: WordPress (Headless/Hybrid), AWS, CI/CD pipelines.
  • AI Workspace: Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot.
What We’re Looking For
  • 5+ Years of Engineering Rigor: You have deep experience in full‑stack environments and understand how to build for scale and reliability.
  • The AI Multiplier Mindset: You are already an expert at using AI tools to write code, debug, and explore technical trade‑offs. You know how to validate AI output with high engineering judgment.
  • Systems Thinkers: You enjoy platform engineering and developer experience. You want to build tools that make other people more productive.
  • Ambiguity Navigators: You can take a loose business requirement and turn it into a concrete technical architecture.
Why This Role is Unique
  • Direct Impact: Every line of code you ship (or prompt you refine) directly improves how our company operates.
  • Modern Culture: We value pragmatic, low‑ego engineering. We care about the "what" and "why," not just the "how".
  • Future‑Proof Your Career: You won't just be "using" AI; you'll be building AI‑native infrastructure, a skill set that is defining the next decade of software engineering.
Benefits

  • Flexible Schedule
  • Paid parental/bereavement leave

  • Top‑notch team to learn and grow with

title: Counsel, Data Privacy & Product Legal
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

At Netflix, we want our members to feel safe and respected while enjoying the stories they love. Our Privacy and Product teams work closely with the business, providing pragmatic support to further develop our services. The team’s overarching goal is to grow and expand the company’s business in a balanced, risk-based manner, considering applicable law and trends, drawing on knowledge and experience with specific government/industry requirements and best practices.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about helping our business partners discern a practical, real-world risk from a theoretical one; has diplomatic skills to unite people together and guide them through impasses by fostering confidence; and thrive in a loosely-coupled world where thoughtfulness and creativity govern, not rule.

The person in this role will oversee the Data Privacy and Product Legal work across LATAM and is based in our São Paulo office. This position sits at the intersection of law, policy and business strategy requiring both hands‑on execution and the ability to influence strategy.

Responsibilities
  • Managing some functions of a privacy program supporting the global team
  • Draft reply to inquiries from the local authorities in alignment with other cross-functional teams
  • Working closely with cross-functional global and local teams to understand and assess risks for new consumer-facing experiences, from ideation to launch
  • Providing risk-calibrated legal guidance to support the global team on topics related to consumer product innovation, privacy, IP, consumer protection and other issues while coordinating with subject matter experts as needed
  • Coordinating with stakeholder partners (mainly the global team and cross functional specialist) to share context on product and legal strategy, ensuring we are supporting stakeholder needs effectively
  • Becoming an expert on our consumer product to help ensure we remain helpful thought partners and advance business objectives
  • Helping to scale our team and legal organization by developing innovative processes to support the above
Qualifications
  • 7+ years working as a lawyer in privacy and product legal.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian and LATAM privacy, consumer and internet regulatory frameworks (LGPD, Marco Civil da Internet, Consumer Law, ECA Digital), programmatic privacy & compliance, and familiarity with international cooperation.
  • Strong track record demonstrating a collaborative approach, effective communication skills, and excellent legal/business judgment
  • Strategic and creative thinker who thrives in a fast‑paced, entrepreneurial environment characterized by ambiguity
  • Demonstrated curiosity and ability to master new areas of tech and law

title: Regional Head of Engineering Latam
description:
Overview

We are Reckitt Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege. Supply Our supply chain is the backbone of our business. It's how we get our trusted products to people all over the world, safely and efficiently. And it's our talented and passionate teams that make this happen. If you're looking for a career in supply chain, there's no better place to be than Reckitt. We offer a variety of exciting opportunities in all areas of the supply chain, from planning and procurement to manufacturing and logistics. You could join our Global Supply Planning team to develop and implement our global supply strategy, or work with our Procurement Centre of Excellence team to negotiate and manage our supplier relationships. Our Manufacturing Excellence team help us improve the efficiency, quality and safety of our manufacturing operations, and our Logistics Excellence team develop new and innovative ways to distribute our products to customers.

Role and responsibilities

The purpose of this role is to oversee all engineering activities within the Latam Region, ensure efficient delivery of the regional supply capital investment plan, the development of capital masterplans, compliance to preferred suppliers list and relevant engineering standards & processes, capital project review and remediation, governance, and ad-hoc support. This involves strategic leadership, risk management, fostering a safety-conscious culture, and close collaboration with factories for seamless execution of capital plans. The role is pivotal in aligning project success criteria with industrial execution, ensuring a commitment to deliver solutions that meet or exceed agreed requirements.

Responsibilities
  • Strategic Leadership: Define the vision and strategy for engineering capital projects across Reckitt's manufacturing sites. Collaborate with senior leadership to align capital masterplans with overall business objectives.
  • Capital Project Management: Establish and maintain effective capital project management systems in line with global standards from idea generation through execution to post investment review. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to capital projects. Drive continuous improvement initiatives in CAPEX execution. Ensure Vertical Start Up of new purchased assets.
  • Governance & Reporting: Ensure capital project governance in compliance of financial requirements. Attend project/factory steercos. Facilitate reporting for Capital Committee and regional requirements.
  • Collaboration and Cross-Functional Engagement: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, production, quality assurance, and R&D. Engage with external stakeholders, regulatory bodies, industry associations and vendors.
  • Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Conduct thorough capital project reviews to minimise execution risks. Develop and implement risk reduction strategies. Ensure compliance with relevant engineering regulations and standards.
  • Training and Education: Provide training and guidance to employees on engineering protocols. Foster a safety-conscious culture throughout the organization.
  • Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis: Lead investigations into capital project deviations. Identify root causes and implement corrective actions to improve the process.
  • Team Development: Mentor and develop engineering managers and teams to build a talent bench. Foster a culture of continuous improvement & collaboration.
Collaborations

Typical connects are with Regional Supply Directors, Site Directors, Operational Managers, Global Quality, Global Health & Safety, Global Technology Engineering Team, Global Supply Excellence and FM Global. To align required functionalities, priorities, roll out plan, benefits, get support to remove barriers, resources allocation, and sync timelines with other initiatives in the Supply Chain and other functions.

Experience and qualifications

The experience we're looking for

  • Essential: Bachelor's degree in an Engineering discipline or related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in engineering out of which 5 years leadership role in Engineering within the CPG industry.
  • Proven track record of successfully implementing engineering capital investment programs.
  • Demonstrated experience in delveiry of Vertical startup.
  • Strong knowledge of relevant regulations and industry best practices.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.

Desirable:

  • 3+ years of experience in regional engineering role role in CPG.
  • Proven experience working in a multinational environment and managing cross-cultural teams with experience working in different geographies
  • Master’s degree in an Engineering discipline or related field.
  • Willingness to travel as required.
Skills for success

Supply Chain Management, Business Partnership, Collaboration, Partnership building, Relationship management, Business accumen, Productivity management, Improve business processes, Advanced analytics, Data analytics, Manufacturing excellence.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

description:
Com um legado único em dermatologia e décadas de inovação de ponta, a Galderma é a líder emergente na categoria de dermatologia, presente em aproximadamente 90 países. Oferecemos um portfólio inovador baseado na ciência de marcas premium e serviços que abrangem todo o espectro do mercado de dermatologia em rápido crescimento através de Estética Injetável, Cuidados Dermatológicos e Dermatologia Terapêutica. Desde a nossa fundação em 1981, dedicamos nossa atenção e paixão ao maior órgão do corpo humano - a pele - atendendo às necessidades individuais de consumidores e pacientes com resultados superiores em parceria com profissionais de saúde. Porque entendemos que a pele em que estamos molda nossas vidas, estamos avançando na dermatologia para cada história de pele.

Procuramos pessoas que se concentrem em obter resultados, abracem a aprendizagem e tragam uma energia positiva. Eles devem combinar iniciativa com um senso de trabalho em equipe e colaboração. Acima de tudo, devem estar apaixonados por fazer algo significativo para os consumidores, pacientes e profissionais de saúde que atendemos todos os dias. Nosso objetivo é capacitar cada funcionário e promover seu crescimento pessoal, garantindo ao mesmo tempo que as necessidades comerciais sejam atendidas agora e no futuro. Em toda a nossa empresa, abraçamos a diversidade e respeitamos a dignidade, a privacidade e os direitos pessoais de cada funcionário.

Na Galderma, damos ativamente às nossas equipes motivos para acreditar em nossa ousada ambição de nos tornarmos a principal empresa de dermatologia do mundo. Com a gente, você tem a oportunidade definitiva de adquirir novas e desafiadoras experiências de trabalho e criar um impacto direto incomparável.

The Site Head at HRT holds a pivotal leadership position, tasked with overseeing all aspects of site operations. This role requires a dynamic leader who can drive operational excellence, strategic growth, and innovation within a manufacturing environment. The Site Head is expected to lead a team of approximately 150 professionals, ensuring the site delivers high-quality, timely, and cost-effective dermatological products to clients. A key aspect of the mandate is to uphold the highest standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration. The Site Head will also be responsible for developing and implementing strategies to enhance product offerings, optimize resource utilization, and strengthen client relationships, positioning the facility as a best in class manufacturing site.

Key Responsibilities
  • Operational Leadership: Oversee daily operations to ensure efficient, safe, and compliant manufacturing activities in line with best manufacturing practices.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with senior leadership and other stakeholders to align site operations with organizational goals and objectives.
  • Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of approximately 150 employees, fostering a culture of excellence, safety, and continuous improvement.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic initiatives to enhance product offerings, optimize resource utilization, and drive growth within the dermatology sector.
  • Growth Management: Plan and oversee the expansion of the site's production capacity from 12 million units to 25 million units annually, ensuring infrastructure, processes, and workforce are aligned to support increased output and meet international market demand.
  • Innovation and Improvement: Lead initiatives to foster a culture of innovation, encouraging creative solutions and forward-thinking approaches. Identify and implement cutting-edge technologies and methodologies to enhance production processes and service delivery. Drive continuous improvement programs that streamline operations, reduce costs, and increase efficiency (including but not limited to Overall Equipment Effectiveness (‘OEE’), ensuring the site remains competitive and at the forefront of industry advancements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to pilot new ideas and adopt best practices that can be scaled across the organization. Champion an environment where employees are empowered to contribute innovative ideas and improvements, supporting a dynamic and agile workplace.
  • Financial Oversight: Manage the site's budget and financial performance, ensuring cost-effective operations and adherence to financial targets.
  • Quality and Compliance: Ensure all operations comply with industry regulations and best practices, maintaining the highest levels of safety and product quality. Continue to develop a Quality culture, and safety-first and right-first-time mindset.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity and operational resilience.
Key Requirements
  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • Leadership Experience: Extensive experience in operations leadership within the dermatology, pharmaceutical, or regulated manufacturing sectors.
  • Industry experience: Previous experience in manufacturing is a must; previous exposure to pharmaceutical manufacturing is a definite advantage.
  • Operational Excellence: Experience in Best Practice (ideally GMP) manufacturing operations at sites that deliver high volumes across multiple SKUs.
  • Site Development Experience: Proven experience in leading major CAPEX initiatives, including building, expanding, and/or transforming manufacturing sites to increase output and create efficiencies.
  • LEAN Manufacturing: Proven track record in implementing LEAN manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies that improve output and OEE. Extensive knowledge of manufacturing automation best practices and technologies preferred.
  • Quality and Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of GMP regulations, industry standards, Quality and QMS best practices, and compliance requirements.
  • Cultural Leadership: A culture ambassador capable of engaging and motivating employees at all levels, fostering a positive and inclusive workplace environment.
  • Strategic Vision: Ability to develop and execute strategic initiatives that drive growth and operational excellence.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with healthcare clients and stakeholders.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills and a hands‑on approach to leadership.
  • Innovation: Demonstrated ability to lead innovation and implement cutting‑edge technologies and processes within a manufacturing setting.

title: National Individual Consultancy for strengthening the legal and governance framework for family[]
description:
Apply now. Job no: . Contract type: Consultant. Duty Station: Podgorica. Level: Consultancy. Location: Montenegro. Categories: Early Childhood Development.

For every child, the best start to life.

Montenegro has made important commitments towards strengthening early childhood development with particular emphasis on improving support to young children with developmental delays and disabilities and their families and created a solid foundation for reform towards a modern, integrated and family centered early intervention system. In recent years, Ministry of Health, supported by UNICEF, has been gradually expanding contemporary, transdisciplinary and routine based family centered early intervention services in several municipalities across Montenegro. Based on this experience, an Operational plan and roadmap for scaling up family centered early childhood intervention in Montenegro ) has been developed. As Montenegro moves from piloting to system level expansion, strengthening the legal and institutional framework becomes essential for sustainability. Existing regulations do not sufficiently define intersectoral mandates, accountability, financing responsibilities, or mechanisms for joint planning and implementation. Without such formalization, large‑scale and equitable access to quality services in the long term remains challenging. The purpose of this assignment is to provide technical support the Government of Montenegro in conducting a detailed desk review of relevant international legislation, laws and regulations in the field of early intervention, to identify good practices that can be adapted to the national context, develop draft amendments to formalise institutional competencies and contribute to the establishment of practical instruments for coordinated implementation. All deliverables should be produced in the local language.

Work Assignments Overview
  • Desk review of existing reports in the area of ECI in Montenegro and relevant existing international legislation in the field of early intervention (Portugal, Spain, Slovenia and other countries with ECI laws), and national legislation in all three sectors (health, education, social welfare). Deliverable: Comparative analytical report on international legislation in early intervention and on provisions that currently exist in the Montenegrin legal framework. Deadline: 13/05/2026.
  • Preparation of amendments and/or new provisions in the Rulebook on standards, norms and manner of realizing primary health care and Decree on entitlements and healthcare standards as per mandatory health insurance to operationalise family centred early intervention in line with the new Healthcare Law. Deliverable: Report describing the necessary amendments and/or new provisions in the Rulebook on primary health care and Decree on entitlements as per mandatory health insurance. Deadline: 30/05/2026.
  • Preparation of draft amendments to formalise competencies in the field of family centred early intervention and support for families of children with developmental delays and disabilities in Montenegro, by identifying provisions that need to be added to sectoral laws, as well as a skeleton of a unified ECI law which can be proposed to the Government for further development and adoption. Deliverable: Report describing a set of realistic and achievable draft legal and regulatory amendments with the aim of formalising competencies in family centred early intervention and family support in three sectors and a skeleton of a unified ECI law. Deadline: 30/06/2026.
  • Development of forms for annual/multi-annual joint planning and definition of joint budgeting methodology. Deliverable: Set of standardised templates for annual and/or multi-annual intersectoral planning and joint budgeting methodology to guide coordinated financing across sectors. Deadline: 15/07/2026.
  • Consultations with national stakeholders from all three sectors to validate and fine‑tune the deliverables. Deliverable: Final reports containing validated set of legal and regulatory amendments and templates. Deadline: 15/09/2026.
  • Developed final consultancy report, describing the consultancy and recommendations regarding the next steps and accepted by UNICEF. Deliverable: Final consultancy report. Deadline: 25/09/2026.
Minimum Requirements Education
  • Law degree.
Experience
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in legal reform, public policy development, governance or institutional strengthening.
  • Proven experience in intersectoral coordination involving multiple government institutions. Relevant experience should be clearly described in the application.
  • Previous work experience with UN/UNICEF or other international organisations will be considered an advantage. Applicants may provide references or relevant documentation as evidence of previous cooperation.
  • Demonstrated experience in drafting or contributing to the development of laws and other regulatory frameworks in the health, education or social welfare sector. Applicants must submit samples of previous relevant work as part of the application.
  • Familiarity with bylaws relating to primary health care in Montenegro.
  • Familiarity with early intervention for children with developmental delays and disabilities.
Language
  • Excellent command of Montenegrin (both spoken and written) while knowledge of other languages in official use in Montenegro will be considered an asset; knowledge of English will be considered an asset.
Other Skills
  • Excellent writing, presentation, strategic and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work with different stakeholders, good networking skills.
  • Demonstrates tact and high sense of responsibility and discretion.
  • Demonstrates integrity and high ethical standards.
  • Displays cultural, gender, religion, race, nationality, age sensitivity and adaptability.
Compensation
  • 1st tranche will be paid upon successful submission of deliverables 1-3.
  • 2nd tranche will be paid upon successful submission of remaining deliverables 4-6.
Required Training and Courses
  • Ethics and Integrity at UNICEF
  • Prevention of Sexual Harassment and Abuse of Authority
  • Prevention of Sexual Exploitation Abuse
  • General Information Security Awareness Course
  • Fraud Awareness (if issued a UNICEF email address)
Evaluation Criteria
  • Technical criteria – Technical evaluation process, max. 70 points
  • Desk review of CVs – 70 % of total evaluation
  • Education – 10 points
  • Previous experience – 20 points
  • Sample of a legal report or piece of legislation that the candidate authored – 30 points
  • Other – 10 points
Legal, Employment and Benefits

UNICEF is committed to diversity and inclusion within its workforce, and encourages all candidates, irrespective of gender, nationality, religious and ethnic backgrounds, including persons living with disabilities, to apply to become a part of the organisation. UNICEF offers reasonable accommodation for consultants/individual contractors with disabilities. This may include, for example, accessible software, travel assistance for missions or personal attendants. We encourage you to disclose your disability during your application in case you need reasonable accommodation during the selection process and afterwards in your assignment.

UNICEF has a zero‑tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. UNICEF also adheres to strict child safeguarding principles. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. Background checks will include the verification of academic credentials and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.

Individuals engaged under a consultancy or individual contract will not be considered “staff members” under the Staff Regulations and Rules of the United Nations and UNICEF’s policies and procedures and will not be entitled to benefits provided therein (such as leave entitlements and medical insurance coverage). Their conditions of service will be governed by their contract and the General Conditions of Contracts for the Services of Consultants and Individual Contractors. Consultants and individual contractors are responsible for determining their tax liabilities and for the payment of any taxes and/or duties, in accordance with local or other applicable laws.

The selected candidate is solely responsible to ensure that the visa (applicable) and health insurance required to perform the duties of the contract are valid for the entire period of the contract. Selected candidates are subject to confirmation of fully vaccinated status against SARS‑CoV‑2 (Covid‑19) with a World Health Organization (WHO)‑endorsed vaccine, which must be met prior to taking up the assignment. It does not apply to consultants who will work remotely and are not expected to work on or visit UNICEF premises, programme delivery locations or directly interact with communities UNICEF works with, nor to travel to perform functions for UNICEF for the duration of their consultancy contracts.

title: Gerente de Turno Senior , Amazon Logistics (Fulfillment & Operations)
description:
The Amazon Logistics team is looking for a Senior Shift Manager to join the AMZL Brazil team at our delivery station (Delivery Station) in Fortaleza - DS, during the day shift.

As Shift Manager, you will be responsible for leading the day's operation of a Delivery Station. Your role will involve providing support and leadership for Team Leaders, Operators, and Delivery Service Providers, in addition to managing relationships and the performance of external agencies.

You will be part of a highly collaborative, dynamic and innovative environment where ideas are valued and experimentation is encouraged. Our goal is to find creative and practical solutions to deliver the best results to our clients. We seek professionals with a history of excellence in quality and customer focus, who thrive in fast and challenging scenarios, and who are ready to work in contexts of high ambiguity and constant change.

If you like challenges and are prepared to lead and deliver results in an environment that combines the dynamism of a start‑up with the structure of a large company, we want to meet you!

Key job responsibilities
  • Be based at one of our delivery points, on the night shift. Amazon operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, so shiftwork will be part of this function, including weekends and holidays;
  • Supervision of the operation that focuses on the delivery of orders from Amazon directly to customers;
  • Support your team of operational leaders in the daily management of the delivery point. This will include labor allocation, meeting leadership, assignment of tasks, and communication with internal and external suppliers;
  • Work with KPIs such as On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success and improve customer service;
  • Think analytically about project management with attention to detail, ability to influence others, and exceptional organizational skills;
  • Be obsessed with metrics and dive deep to find root causes quickly to generate improvements;
  • Find practical and simple solutions to complex problems without sacrificing quality or core functionality. Utilizing exceptional problem‑solving and communication skills to influence business and technical audiences;
  • Provide daily support during the implementation/implementation of new systems/processes and collect feedback;
  • Mapping business requirements, understanding business processes, studying and analyzing workflows, and designing solutions;
  • Continuously use software and hardware tools to ensure normal day‑to‑day operations. Ensure that associates have the appropriate tools to perform the job and coordinate repair or replacement when necessary;
  • Communicate daily metrics and report exceptions to other Operations departments and across Amazon as needed.
Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Experience in employee and performance management
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques
  • Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

title: Vice President, Enterprise Strategy
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Vice President, Enterprise Strategy

Overview

Join our dynamic Strategy and Execution team. This strategy role is ideal for someone passionate about payments and innovation. Our team focuses on Commercial and New Payment flows – payments made and received by small business & large corporations, and money movement transactions (e.g., P2P) via our Mastercard Move capabilities. We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments and businesses realize their greatest potential. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.

Role
  • Partners with business leaders within CNPF to design, evaluate and advance their strategies, with a strong focus on in-market delivery and implementation.
  • Contribute to the CNPF’s overall strategy through thought leadership and creativity.
  • Build strong, cross-functional alignment with key stakeholders across MA (e.g., Core Payments, Services, regional leadership and other function groups etc.) to drive execution.
  • Identify, structure, and prioritize cross-functional initiatives (e.g., secular shift opportunities, market-level execution plans, key product priorities, etc.) to generate actionable recommendations.
  • Apply strategic and analytical rigor to product and regional strategies, acting as a thought partner.
  • Maintain knowledge of the commercial and money movement landscape and market trends to develop innovative solutions and product strategies.
  • Share learnings and insights with Divisional Presidents, Country Managers, and other key stakeholders, where relevant.
  • Management of cross functional teams to drive outputs and deliverables.
All About You
  • Extensive experience in strategy consulting or developing go-to-market strategies for payments.
  • Extensive experience of translating strategies to execution plans, driving end to end execution – particularly in a cross-functional environment.
  • Strong understanding of Mastercard's products, services, and key revenue drivers, as well as the larger payment industry.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills to work with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analytical and solutions-oriented with the ability to drive thought leadership in commercial payments & money movement.
Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Head of Shareholders Relations - Latin America
description:
Position Overview

Patria Investments (ticker PAX), a NASDAQ listed alternative asset manager with over $50bn of Assets under Management (AUM), is seeking an experienced investor relations professional to serve as a VP in Shareholder Relations focused on the LATAM region. This highly visible position, which will report to the Global Head of Shareholder Relations and work closely with senior management, will be responsible for overseeing all PAX investor relations activities in Latin America including building and maintaining relationships with both the buy-side and the sell-side, as well as the continued development of Patria’s brand awareness within the broader investment community. In addition, the position will contribute to and support Patria’s broader global Shareholder Relations efforts and offers unparallel access to senior management of the largest alternative asset manager in the region, as Patria fills a prominent role in the dynamic and growing global alternative asset management industry.

Key Responsibilities – Market of focus: Latin America
  • Strategic GTM & Relationship Management: Develop and execute the Latin America shareholder relations strategy, focusing on expanding PAX’s investor base and strengthening relationships with regional buy-side and sell-side analysts.
  • Strategic Communication & Public Affairs: Lead all investor communications in LATAM, ensuring alignment with global objectives. Partner with Corporate Communications to execute public affairs initiatives that elevate Patria’s brand and reputation within the regional financial industry.
  • Market Intelligence & Competitor Analysis: Monitor local market trends, regulatory changes, and competitor performance. Conduct deep-dive industry analysis using tools like Visible Alpha and Irwin to support senior management’s strategic decision-making.
  • Financial Modeling & Earnings Support: Manage and maintain IR financial models, monitoring analysts’ forecasts and valuation methodologies. Coordinate with FP&A to prepare quarterly earnings materials and shareholder presentations, ensuring effective pre- and post-earnings engagement.
  • Event Leadership & Reporting: Organize regional non-deal roadshows and investor events to enhance market visibility. Act as a strategic feedback loop, providing senior management with real-time insights into investor sentiment and market attitudes toward Patria’s performance.
The ideal candidate
  • A minimum of 8 years of financial industry experience and a minimum of 3 years in an Investor Relations leadership position
  • Finance industry experience within the region is essential, preferably with a background in or exposure to the alternative investment management industry
  • Network: strong relationships with both the buy-side and sell-side communities in Brazil and throughout LATAM
  • Experience in working effectively on a team and communicating with and reporting directly to senior management
  • Excellent communication skills and analytical capabilities
  • Native Portuguese and fluent English. Fluency in Spanish is a plus.
  • Availability to travel extensively throughout the region with occasional travel to U.S. and London
  • Sao Paulo based

Join Patria and be part of a team dedicated to growth, innovation, and excellence in the dynamic and growing alternative asset management industry. If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for shareholder relations and public affairs, we invite you to apply and be a key player in shaping Patria's future.

Nós os ajudamos a reinventar a maneira como os profissionais trabalham, nossa equipe de especialistas reúne informação, inovação e insight para desvendar situações complexas nos mercados Tributário, Comercio Exterior, Contábil e Jurídico, respaldando nossos clientes na tomada de decisão.

Sobre a Posição / About the Role
  • Fazer chamadas telefônicas ativas para clientes e prospects para agendar reuniões para as equipes de vendas;
  • Identificar, gerar e qualificar novos leads de vendas por meio de análises de clientes, processos de marketing preditivo;
  • Explicar os benefícios dos produtos e serviços da Thomson Reuters a potenciais clientes de maneira concisa que desperte curiosidade adicional sobre os produtos;
  • Prospectar novos clientes e leads atribuídos como parte de um grupo de recursos compartilhados;
  • Compreender arquétipos específicos de clientes e necessidades que são mais prevalentes dentro do subsegmento e território;
  • Identificação de prospects, aquisição de dados de contato;
  • Executar campanhas de vendas, incluindo a criação de e-mails sequenciais para gerar novas oportunidades de vendas;
  • Utilizar plataformas de mídia social para se conectar e qualificar ainda mais leads potenciais;
  • Testar novas ferramentas de capacitação de vendas;
  • Metas principais incluem o volume do pipeline gerado, número de reuniões agendadas, valor total do pipeline criado, receita total de negócios fechados a partir de reuniões agendadas, tempo de resposta ao lead.
Sobre você / About You
  • Experiência comprovada como SDR ou em função similar;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no modelo híbrido;
  • Experiência com o segmento SaaS;
  • Será um diferencial ter atuado com produtos jurídicos
O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível (2-3 dias por semana no escritório, dependendo do papel) para funções baseadas em escritório, garantindo uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto presencial.

  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: "Flex My Way" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.

  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa "Grow My Way" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.

  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.

  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.

  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).

  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? Faça parte da nossa equipe e contribua para moldar as indústrias que impulsionam o progresso da sociedade.

Como uma empresa global, confiamos no conhecimento único, perspectivas e experiências de todos os colaboradores para cumprir nossos objetivos comerciais. Para garantir que possamos fazer isso, buscamos colaboradores talentosos e qualificados em todas as nossas operações ao redor do mundo, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo/gênero, incluindo gestantes, identidade e expressão de gênero, origem nacional, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, deficiência, idade, estado civil, status de cidadania, ou outra classificação protegida pela lei aplicável.

A empresa de logística para o mundo! O Deutsche Post e a DHL formam o maior grupo de correspondência e logística do mundo. Juntos, temos um portfólio inigualável de produtos padronizados e soluções personalizadas inovadoras. Como um dos maiores e mais inovadores empregadores do mundo, nos orgulhamos especialmente de nossos colaboradores. Comunicação assertiva, trabalho em equipe, relacionamento interpessoal, pensamento analítico e resolução de problemas. Capacidade para gerenciar e/ou analisar demandas de natureza diferentes simultaneamente, gerando resultados assertivos.

Responsável pela gestão do time da célula centralizada (emissões e planejamento) objetivando a gestão de pessoas, gestão da rotina, ações de melhoria e formação de equipe de alta performance.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in‑house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and the Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers’ compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment‑related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in‑house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in‑house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy. The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment‑related and labor‑related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in‑house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in‑house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters. Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership. The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective‑bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi‑legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed. Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers. Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions. Responds to University officials’ request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility. Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University. Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems. Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action. Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures. Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies. Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics. Ability to participate effectively in fact‑finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations. Ability to articulate the University’s position, listen and negotiate effectively. Superior verbal and written communication skills. Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision. Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines. Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction. Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, union representatives and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and six years of post J.D. legal experience which includes at least four years of substantial employment experience, with additional knowledge of the labor process. A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and eight years of substantial labor and employment experience. All candidates must have a strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar is required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure Salary Range

The anticipated salary for the Senior Associate General Counsel position is $207,800.

title: Machine Learning Engineer AA-05
description:
We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Campaign Delivery team. This role is central to designing and deploying predictive models and recommendation systems that power how campaigns are matched to the right users at the right time. Youll partner closely with Data Engineers, Product Managers, and Campaign Operations to build ML solutions that directly improve delivery performance, advertiser outcomes, and platform efficiency.

A key focus will be developing and iterating on models that optimize campaign targeting, pacing, and conversion prediction across delivery infrastructure. Youll work with large-scale behavioral and event data to train, evaluate, and deploy models that operate in real-time production environments.

A major initiative will be automating the conversion review process. Today, conversion approvals involve manual effort to distinguish legitimate installs and post-install events from fraudulent or low-quality traffic. You will design and deploy ML models that score conversions in real time, flag suspicious patterns, and progressively automate approval decisions—reducing manual review volume while protecting advertiser spend and publisher trust. This work sits at the intersection of anomaly detection, classification, and production ML, and will directly shape how quality assurance scales across the delivery pipeline.

This is a hands-on modeling role. You will build, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models end-to-end—not integrate third-party AI APIs or wrap LLM services.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and deploy ML models to automate the conversion review and approval process—scoring conversions for legitimacy and flagging fraudulent or low-quality traffic patterns.

Por que fazer parte do nosso time?

Somos uma empresa empenhada em fazer nossas crenças e valores acontecerem de verdade. O objetivo é proporcionar a você um ambiente de qualidade, diverso e seguro para que você desenvolva o seu melhor. Para isso, oferecemos os melhores benefícios:

  • Especial para você e sua família: Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação!

  • Transporte fretado, refeições no local de trabalho, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, Apoio e orientação: Jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico.
Como estamos comprometidos com a sua segurança?

Nada é mais importante para nós do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Para que isso aconteça, temos os padrões de segurança mais rigorosos do setor. Além disso, também estamos investindo continuamente em novas tecnologias, de drones a análise de dados, que estão ajudando a tornar a mineração mais segura.

Inclusão e Diversidade

Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, no qual valorizamos e respeitamos cada colega por quem ela/ele é. Acolhemos e celebramos todas as identidades de gênero, etnias, idades, espiritualidades, orientações sexuais, deficiências, classes sociais, estilos de vida e habilidades. E foi para escutar todas essas vozes que criamos os Grupos de Afinidades: espaços seguros para discutir, refletir e construir ações de inclusão e diversidade no âmbito da equidade de gênero, LGBTQIAP+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e geracional.

Nós queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e sintam-se abertos para trazer seu “verdadeiro eu” para o trabalho.

*Reforçamos que todas as vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitados do INSS.

Para se candidatar a essa vaga, realize seu cadastro on-line, e anexe seu currículo no ato da inscrição.

Fique atento à página da/do candidata/candidato, assim como aos meios de comunicação (e-mail, telefone, WhatsApp), pois todo o processo será mediado por essas plataformas.

title: Sr. Generative AI Specialist Solutions Architect, Brazil
description:
Description

Você gosta de IA Generativa (GenAI)? Quer ajudar a definir o futuro da AWS e de seus clientes brasileiros usando IA generativa? Nesta função, você ajudará nossos clientes a criar e implantar aplicativos habilitados para GenAI usando Amazon Bedrock e SageMaker, ajustar e criar modelos de IA generativa e ajudar os clientes corporativos a aproveitar esses modelos para potencializar aplicativos finais. Você se envolverá com proprietários de produtos para influenciar a direção do produto e ajudar nossos clientes a entrar em novos mercados utilizando GenAI junto com os serviços da AWS. Na Amazon, investimos profundamente em inteligência artificial há mais de 20 anos, e muitos dos recursos que os clientes experimentam são impulsionados pelo aprendizado de máquina. O mecanismo de recomendações da Amazon.com é impulsionado por aprendizado de máquina (ML), assim como os caminhos que otimizam as rotas de coleta robótica em nossos centros de distribuição. Nossa cadeia de suprimentos, previsões e planejamento de capacidade também são informados por algoritmos de ML. Alexa é alimentada por aprendizado profundo de compreensão de linguagem natural e reconhecimento automatizado de fala; assim como o Prime Air e a tecnologia de visão computacional em nossa nova experiência de varejo, Amazon Go. Temos milhares de engenheiros na Amazon comprometidos com o aprendizado de máquina e o aprendizado profundo, e isso é uma grande parte de nossa herança.

Role Overview

A AWS está procurando uma Pessoas Arquitetas de Soluções de IA generativa, que será especialista no assunto (SME) para ajudar os clientes a projetarem soluções que aproveitem nossos serviços de IA generativa. Como parte da equipe mundial de arquitetura de soluções especializadas, você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outros arquitetos especialistas em aprendizado de máquina de várias regiões para permitir casos de uso de clientes em grande escala e impulsionar a adoção de Amazon Web Services para plataformas de ML/AI. Você interagirá com outras pessoas arquitetas de soluções na área, fornecendo orientação sobre o envolvimento de seus clientes, e desenvolverá white papers, blogs, implementações de referência e apresentações para permitir que clientes e parceiros aproveitem totalmente ML/IA na Amazon Web Services. Você também criará materiais de capacitação de campo para a população mais ampla do SA, para ajudá-los a entender como integrar soluções de ML da Amazon Web Services às arquiteturas dos clientes. Você promoverá a coleta eficaz de feedback dos clientes e os traduzirá em requisitos comerciais e técnicos claros para serem revisados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia. Você irá continuar a patrocinar a criação de novos produtos e recursos a partir desses requisitos, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com as equipes de produto e engenharia para minimizar o desvio dos requisitos das necessidades do seu cliente.

Você deverá ter profunda experiência técnica trabalhando com tecnologias relacionadas à geração de imagens multimodais, desde o ajuste fino do modelo até a engenharia imediata. É preferível uma sólida experiência em aprendizado de máquina em desenvolvimento, além de experiência na construção de aplicativos e design de arquitetura. Você estará familiarizado com o ecossistema de fornecedores de software no espaço de IA/ML e aproveitará esse conhecimento para ajudar os clientes da Amazon Web Services em seu processo de seleção. As pessoas candidatas devem ter ótimas habilidades de comunicação e serem muito técnicas, com capacidade de impressionar os clientes da Amazon Web Services em qualquer nível, do executivo ao desenvolvedor. Experiência anterior com Amazon Web Services é desejada, mas não obrigatória, desde que você tenha experiência na construção de soluções em larga escala. Você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar diretamente com engenheiros seniores de ML e cientistas de dados de clientes, parceiros e equipes de serviços da Amazon Web Services, influenciando seus roteiros e impulsionando a inovação.

Key Responsibilities
  • Liderança inovadora – Evangelizar os serviços AWS GenAI e compartilhar as melhores práticas por meio de fóruns como blogs da AWS, white papers, arquiteturas de referência e eventos de palestras públicas, como AWS Summit, AWS re:Invent, etc.
  • Fazer parceria com equipes de SAs, vendas, desenvolvimento de negócios e serviços de IA/ML para acelerar a adoção do cliente e fornecer orientação sobre seus compromissos com o cliente.
  • Atuar como um elo técnico entre os clientes e as equipes de serviços de AIML da AWS para fornecer feedback de melhoria do produto orientado ao cliente.
  • Desenvolver e apoiar uma comunidade interna da AWS de especialistas em assuntos relacionados a ML em todo o mundo. Criar materiais de capacitação de campo para a população mais ampla de SA, para ajudá-los a entender como integrar soluções GenAI da Amazon Web Services às arquiteturas dos clientes.
  • Consultor do cliente - Implementar e implantar algoritmos de aprendizado de máquina de última geração sob Gen AI. Você construirá protótipos, PoCs e explorará novas soluções. Você interagirá de perto com nossos clientes e com a comunidade acadêmica.
About the Team

Experiências Diversas

A Amazon valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades desejáveis listadas na descrição da vaga, encorajamos os candidatos a se inscreverem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o impeça de se candidatar.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros na computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — é por isso que clientes, desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até as empresas da Global 500, confiam em nosso robusto conjunto de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.

Work-Life Balance

Valorizamos a harmonia entre vida pessoal e profissional. Alcançar o sucesso no trabalho nunca deve acontecer às custas de sacrifícios em casa, e é por isso que buscamos a flexibilidade como parte de nossa cultura de trabalho. Quando nos sentimos apoiados no trabalho e em casa, não há nada que não possamos alcançar na nuvem.

Inclusive Team Culture

Aqui na AWS, aprender e ser curioso é da nossa natureza. Nossos grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários promovem uma cultura de inclusão que nos permite ter orgulho de nossas diferenças. Eventos e experiências de aprendizado contínuos, incluindo nossas conferências Conversas sobre Raça e Etnia (CORE) e AmazeCon (diversidade de gênero), nos inspiram a nunca deixar de abraçar nossa singularidade.

Mentoring and Career Growth

Estamos constantemente elevando nosso padrão de desempenho enquanto nos esforçamos para nos tornarmos o Melhor Empregador do Mundo. É por isso que você encontrará aqui inúmeros recursos de compartilhamento de conhecimento, mentoria e outros recursos para o avanço da sua carreira, que o ajudarão a se tornar um profissional mais completo.

Basic Qualifications
  • 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
Preferred Qualifications
  • 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
  • Experience working with end user or developer communities
  • 5+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English

Até 2030, queremos ser o grupo que mais contribui para uma sociedade mais saudável. Para isso, entendemos que o nosso compromisso vai além do cuidado com a saúde individual. É preciso cuidar das pessoas, dos negócios e do planeta.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Na RD Saúde, assumimos o compromisso de incluir e empoderar nossos(as) funcionários(as) por meio da promoção da diversidade e da inclusão. Valorizamos as pessoas, construindo uma cultura acolhedora e de respeito a todos e todas. Seja quem você é aqui!

Nossa jornada começou em novembro de 2011, fruto da união entre Raia e Drogasil, crescendo até se tornar a maior rede de farmácias do Brasil e expandindo para além do varejo farmacêutico, integrando soluções B2B e plataformas digitais.
